subject: Channel Private Offer coordination for CloudResellCo - kickoff & next steps
messages:
From: Sanjay Iyer <sanjay@cloudresellco.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Channel Private Offer request & launch timing

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for taking this on. We (CloudResellCo) are preparing a channel private offer (CPPO) for a joint customer (Acme Platform) and want to align on the operational items so we can go-live by 2026-01-28. High-level: estimated first-year committed spend $420k ARR, expected subscription SKUs, and a reseller billing entity in the US.

Can you confirm the Redwood checklist for CPPO activation, and what you need from us to fast-track the DocuSign & entitlement mapping? Specifically:
- AWS seller account IDs you need
- Preferred invoice routing / chargeback approach
- Any required compliance docs or evidence for marketplace listing

Happy to share our procurement contact (procurement@acmeplatform.io) and an estimate of seat counts. Would prefer a kickoff this week if possible.

Thanks,
Sanjay Iyer
Head of Partnerships
CloudResellCo

Attachment: none (details to follow)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Iyer <sanjay@cloudresellco.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Channel Private Offer request & launch timing

Sanjay — thanks, and congrats on the pipeline. Quick reply with concrete next steps so we can hit 1/28: 

1) Kickoff call — propose Wed 2026-01-14 10:00 PT (30m) to collect account IDs and confirm pricing matrix. Laura & Ben will cover ops & billing.
2) Docs we need from you today: AWS Seller account IDs, legal entity name for invoicing, and the procurement contact info for DocuSign.
3) I’m attaching our CPPO checklist + a basic reseller pricing matrix so we can align SKUs and entitlements.

I’ve looped in Laura (ops lead) and Ben (billing). After the kickoff we’ll create a mutual action plan with owners and dates. If 1/28 is at risk we’ll call a second go-live window but let’s try to keep momentum.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Manager, Channel
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- CPPO_checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
- resell_pricing_matrix.csv (text/csv)

Jordan — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming answers in-line:
- AWS Seller account ID: 1234-5678-9012
- Invoicing entity: CloudResellCo LLC (EIN: 12-3456789) — billing email: billing@cloudresellco.com
- Procurement contact: procurement@acmeplatform.io (I’ve CC’d them).

We reviewed your CPPO_checklist and filled the first tab — attaching the annotated matrix. We’d like the offer to cover monthly seat subscriptions and an annual enterprise bundle. We’ll need a DocuSign routing to our procurement contact once Redwood legal confirms the master exhibit.

Proposed time for the kickoff looks good — Laura/Ben, Jordan, any conflict?

Thanks,
Sanjay

Olga — forwarding the thread from CloudResellCo. They provided seller account ID and invoicing entity. Can you do two things before our Wed call:
1) Entitlement mapping: match their SKUs in the attached pricing matrix to Redwood marketplace SKUs and confirm which SKUs require private-offer entitlements vs public listing.
2) Legal: flag any standard redlines we typically require on CPPO exhibits (I can route to legal if you prefer).

On Wed we’ll align owner for DocuSign sequencing. Quick note on risk: if entitlement mapping requires entity mapping changes we may need an extra 48 hours to complete AWS-side activation.

Jordan / Olga — quick ops note ahead of the kickoff:
- AWS settlement: for CPPOs we need the payee mapping confirmed in AWS Marketplace (CloudResellCo as reseller + Redwood as publisher). I’ve sketched an invoicing split we usually use for reseller-involved CPPOs and attached a short memo.
- HubSpot: I created tracker HS-0045821 and added a checklist with billing owner = Ben Carter.
- Risks: if CloudResellCo requires invoicing to an alternate entity (e.g., regional sub if they route to EU), that will trigger additional entity verification and a 3–5 day delay.

I’ll bring the invoicing_split.pdf to the kickoff and can share the settlement contact at AWS (aws-settlement@amazon.com) during the call.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi all — calendar invite sent for Wed 2026-01-21 10:00 PT (30m). Agenda:
1) Confirm AWS seller account & payee mapping (Ben)
2) Entitlement mapping & SKU alignment (Olga)
3) Legal & DocuSign sequencing (Jordan)
4) Go/no-go checklist and next milestone dates (Laura)

Links: HubSpot deal HS-0045821, CPPO checklist (shared drive), DocuSign envelope (ENVELOPE12345). Please review the attached materials before the meeting: CPPO_checklist.xlsx, resell_pricing_matrix.csv, invoicing_split.pdf.

If anything changes on budget or scope that would push go-live beyond 1/28, let me know today so we can adjust the M.A.P.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the call.

Laura Bennett
